list.name: WeKnora
list.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

list.description: Command-line tool that allows searching and downloading app packages (known as ipa files) for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS from the App Store.

list.name: Fabric

list.name: ollama
list.description: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.

list.name: caveman
list.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman

list.name: certificates
list.description: 🛡️ A private certificate authority (X.509 & SSH) & ACME server for secure automated certificate management, so you can use TLS everywhere & SSO for SSH.

list.name: katana
list.description: A next-generation crawling and spidering framework.

list.name: engram
list.description: Persistent memory system for AI coding agents. Agent-agnostic Go binary with SQLite + FTS5, MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI.

list.name: grpc-gateway
list.description: gRPC to JSON proxy generator following the gRPC HTTP spec

list.name: tailscale
list.description: The easiest, most secure way to use WireGuard and 2FA.

list.name: tailcat
list.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane

list.name: semantic-router
list.description: A programmable Mixture-of-Models router for heterogeneous LLM inference

list.name: netbird

list.name: seaweedfs
list.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.
